stage: E4: fresh-log confirmation of prospective joint context/action sampling
history: Chosen after E4/E4b development; all development attempts retained. No confirmation seeds evaluated before this file. Frozen policies and OptDigits context pool previously inspected; this is fresh-log confirmation, not a new dataset.
success: Mean all-real-edit certified utility floor strictly positive with 95% seed-cluster bootstrap lower endpoint >0; no harmful feasible attacks and no possible harmful outcomes under certificates. Compare to always-retain and original logging at same n/epsilon. Report every design/cell and all adaptive-attack gaps.
inference: 200 common-random-number seed clusters, shared across designs/libraries/budgets/n. Paired bootstrap 10000 resamples seed 87421. Per-cell harm Clopper-Pearson upper 95%; never pool correlated library outcomes. Simultaneous alpha=.05 only across three candidates within a fixed gate, not a global claim across designs.
threat: White-box reward-only edits, at most floor(n*epsilon) rows, arbitrary replacement in [0,1]. Policies, reward model, contexts, actions and propensities trusted and frozen. Search uses binary flips; deterministic envelopes cover real-valued replacements. Oracle attacker knows true candidate ordering; defender does not.

attack.method: universal score envelopes; targeted top-k witnesses; adaptive active-branch MILP with competitor cutting planes; validate actual final gate
attack.incomplete_search: retain unresolved interval; never label failed search robust

design: Q(x,a) proportional to maximum absolute policy difference, mixed with baseline joint distribution and 1% support floor. Shared design based on all six candidates. Original P_X is uniform; estimator uses delta/(N_X Q). Prospective active access to unlabeled context pool is required. Q and all confidence quantities exclude evaluation labels.
baselines: Original logging; action-only disagreement sampling; uniform actions/contexts; joint RMS difference sampling, which minimizes mean candidate second moment before support mixing. Nominal and corrected centered gates plus retain for each design.
cost: All methods spend n sampled reward observations; main corruption cap floor(.005*n). Report query-context shift, incumbent-relative collection reward cost on queried contexts, and worst-case rejection envelope under uniform context arrivals. No claim to improve total end-to-end reward at zero collection cost.
